title: Butcher Shop Sabotaged, Windows Smashed (Denmark)
content: Received anonymously: On July 19th the so-called “Slagter Morten” who sells dead bodies in Kerteminde, Denmark, was visited by activists. Six windows, a door and some electronics were destroyed. The pictures are taken by the animal abuser.

Last San Diego Fur Store Closed by ALF (2013)

2,000 mink were liberated from Tonn’s Mink Farm in Massillon, Ohio on the morning of July 3, 2025. The farm has been in operation since 1964 without a visit from the Animal Liberation Front.

Dennis Tonn just made a salient pitch for illegal direct action. He told the media he is barely scraping by, and this raid will make it difficult, if not impossible, for him to continue killing mink.

ALF cells in Ohio have carried out many incredible actions over the past few years, all without a single arrest.

Tens of thousands of mink were freed from one of the largest fur farms in the country, Lion Farms, back in November 2022. The farm closed as a result. 1,000 mink were liberated in November 2022 from Hofacre Mink Farm, in the town of Dalton.

30 foxes were liberated from the now-closed Grand River Fur Exchange in Rome, Ohio. Vehicles were sabotaged in February 2023 at Schmitt Fur Farm in Fort Recovery, Ohio.

After the raid on Lion Farms, a journalist asked if I had a message for fur farmers. My message was “Get out before the ALF forces you out.” I was an unknowing prophet. The masked liberators of the ALF will continue to unlatch the cages that confine the innocent and drive this industry into the ground.

title: Last San Diego Fur Store Closed by ALF (2013)
content:
Windows Smashed at Animal Abuse Establishment Twice in Two Nights (St. Louis, USA)

13 years ago, armed with paint stripper, spraypaint, glue, butyric acid, and glass etching solution, the ALF closed San Diego’s only independent fur store.

The storefront and the homes of the owner and manager were sabotaged.

Illegal direct action achieved in one night what twenty years of protest could not.

“These actions were taken to vocalize the cries of the millions of wild animals yearning for freedom. This is in vain unless it inspires others to liberate and sabotage. Every fur farm prisoner deserves a jailbreak.
